What We Offer

Training built
around you.

Not a template. Not a class. A fully personalized experience designed to get you real, lasting results.

01

1-on-1 Coaching

Every session is just you and your trainer. Undivided attention, real-time corrections, and accountability that group classes simply can't match.

02

Custom Programming

No two clients get the same plan. Your workout is built from scratch around your goals, fitness level, injury history, and lifestyle.

03

Private Home Gym

A fully equipped private training space — no crowds, no waiting, no judgement. Just focused work in a clean, comfortable environment.

04

Stretch Therapy

Danielle is also a NASM Certified Stretch & Flexibility Coach, offering dedicated stretch therapy sessions for recovery and mobility.

05

Flexible Scheduling

Sessions booked around your life — mornings, evenings, or weekends. We work with your schedule, not against it.

06

Progress Tracking

Every session is logged so you can see exactly how far you've come and where you're headed next.

Meet the Founder

Danielle Mills

NASM Certified Personal Trainer & Stretch Coach · 6 Years Experience

Hi, I'm Danielle — founder and owner of Misfit Fitness Club, a private personal training gym right out of my garage in Denville, NJ.

As a NASM Certified Personal Trainer, I design programs tailored to your individual goals, whether that's functional fitness, strength training, or bodybuilding-style workouts. I also offer stretch therapy sessions as a NASM Certified Stretch & Flexibility Coach — great for recovery and mobility.

Over the past six years I've worked as a personal trainer and fitness coach for an all-women's training group, with clients ranging from 14 to over 60 years old. No matter your age or experience level, it's never too late to become the best version of yourself.
